t_advice_summary_textbox.text: There are 8 gnomes with various colours. The gnomes will pick either a red or yellow basket. Pink, brown, purple and red gnomes will pick the red basket. Yellow, orange, blue and green gnomes will pick the yellow basket. Stick with one colour basket if it's getting a lot of mushrooms. However, once the numbers of mushroom starts decreasing, then choose the other basket colour (by picking the corresponding gnome colour).
